messages:
maria: Quick async check — preparing rwd-llama-3b-v2 for catalog rollout. Two blockers I want to confirm: 1) weights path ready in s3 (we've got both fp16 and q4_0) 2) tokenizer lowercasing drops <special> tokens (seen in evals). Also want to pin version and plan canary regions. Ping if you're on it.

ajay: I uploaded weights to s3://rwd-models/llama/rwd-llama-3b-v2/weights/{fp16,q4_0}/.sha256 files done. CI checksum passed. One thing: model card expects `eos_token_id: 2` but the config in repo has `eos_token_id: null`.

tim: saw tokenizer issue — the tokenizer repo is applying .lower() in preprocessing for some inputs. That strips tokens like <HOLD> used by system prompts. I'll open a quick PR to stop lowercasing special tokens.

olivia: I'll run the config linter and the model-serving validator now. If it fails, can we fallback to rwd-llama-3b-v1 in the canary policy?

canary-bot: Created canary job canary-llama-3b-v2-us-west-2 at 1802505000. Routing policy: 5% traffic, fallback: rwd-llama-3b-v1, regions enabled: us-west-2 only.

maria: Perfect. Oliva — if validator flags eos_token, add patch to model-config.yaml: ```eos_token_id: 2``` Also add `special_tokens_regex: '<[^>]+>'` to tokenizer config to avoid lowercasing. Quick note: pin spec should be `rwd-llama-3b@v2.0.0` not v2 (we want semver).

ajay: Copy. I'll update the catalog entry and add the pin. Also adding `variants: [q4_0, fp16]` and `fallbacks: [rwd-llama-3b@v1.3.1]`.

tim: PR opened: #2345 — stops lowercasing for tokens matching `<...>`. Added unit test. @maria can you review?

maria: Reviewing now, will merge once CI passes. Also pinging @deploy-bot — after merge can you schedule a dry-run deploy to staging and run the prefix-caching smoke test?

deploy-bot: Scheduled dry-run deploy rwd-llama-3b-v2 -> staging at 1802505200. Smoke tests: prefix-cache, kv-cache warmup, latency-check. I'll post results.

olivia: Linter failed on `max_sequence_length` mismatch (config 2048 vs model 4096). I suggest set `max_sequence_length: 4096` in model-config.yaml and add a validator rule to warn if model weights indicate longer context.

ajay: I've updated model-config in PR #567 to set max_sequence_length: 4096 and pinned version tag. Also updated `regions: [us-west-2, eu-central-1]` but left eu disabled for canary until staging verifies.

maria: Thanks everyone. Plan: merge PRs, run dry-run, then enable canary in us-west-2 for 5% with fallbacks and monitor latency/cost for 48h. If green, broaden to eu-central-1 at 1% then ramp. I'll post a short follow-up when canary goes live. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: Smoke tests passed at 1802505280. Latency p95 93ms, kv-cache hit-rate 78% (expected ~80%).

tim: Merged #2345. Noted small tokenization eval diff ~0.3% on safety prompts — acceptable for canary.

maria: Great. Marking this thread resolved unless new issues come up.
